guide_enrichment.narrative: For us, the disagreement starts with Clemson’s offense being asked to create a substantial margin against a defense our numbers rate highly. Clemson produced season highs in total offense, passing and rushing against North Carolina, but true freshman Tait Reynolds was making his first career start. We view that performance as encouraging context, not enough evidence to dismiss Clemson’s weaker longer-run efficiency in the run game, passing game and scoring-opportunity creation.
guide_enrichment.matchup_to_watch: We are focused on Clemson’s offense against Miami’s defensive front. Miami led the ACC in rushing, scoring and total defense in 2025, returned defensive tackles Ahmad Moten Sr. and Justin Scott, and added Damon Wilson II after his nine-sack season at Missouri. Clemson may still control the game, but our concern is whether its offense can consistently finish drives and create the separation the market is demanding. Our projected margin differs only modestly from that price, so the football case is not strong enough for us to act.

recent_game.fact: Miami improved to 2-0 with a 77-7 home win over Florida A&M on Sept. 10, 2026.
Miami set a program record with 856 total yards and an ACC record with 42 first downs against Florida A&M; its 77 points tied the program record.
Against Florida A&M, Miami produced 430 rushing yards, 426 passing yards and averaged 11.7 yards per play.
Miami scored on 11 of its first 12 possessions against Florida A&M.
Florida A&M was limited to four first downs and 107 total offensive yards, including 37 rushing yards, in Miami's most recent game.

quarterback.fact: Darian Mensah transferred to Miami from Duke in January 2026 after previously playing at Tulane.
Mensah completed 14 of 15 passes for 252 yards, three touchdowns and no interceptions against Florida A&M.
Through two 2026 games, Mensah had completed 41 of 45 passes for 653 yards, eight touchdowns and no interceptions.
Mensah threw for 401 yards and five touchdowns on 27-of-30 passing in his Miami debut at Stanford.
Backup quarterback Luke Nickel completed all eight of his passes for 144 yards and three touchdowns against Florida A&M.

offensive_personnel.fact: Four of Miami's five starting offensive linemen from 2025 departed for the NFL, including drafted tackles Francis Mauigoa and Markel Bell and guard Anez Cooper.
Miami started left tackle Samson Okunlola, left guard SJ Alofaituli, center Ryan Rodriguez, right guard Max Buchanan and right tackle Matthew McCoy in each of its first two 2026 games.
Wide receiver Cooper Barkate followed Mensah from Duke to Miami after recording 72 catches for 1,106 yards and seven touchdowns for Duke in 2025.
Malachi Toney had four catches for 96 yards and one touchdown against Florida A&M after setting a Miami single-game record with 234 receiving yards at Stanford.
Freshman running back Javian Mallory rushed 10 times for 142 yards and two touchdowns against Florida A&M, including a 52-yard touchdown run.
Mark Fletcher Jr. rushed for 105 yards against Florida A&M and moved to sixth in Miami career rushing with 2,458 yards.
Miami returned its top six rushers from 2025 and 97.9 percent of its rushing output from that season.

defensive_personnel.fact: Miami lost 2025 edge defenders Rueben Bain Jr. and Akheem Mesidor to the first round of the 2026 NFL Draft.
Defensive tackles Ahmad Moten Sr. and Justin Scott, both starters in the 2025 national championship game, returned for 2026 and started Miami's first two games.
Miami added edge defender Damon Wilson II from Missouri after he started all 13 games and recorded nine sacks in 2025.
Miami also added defensive linemen Keona Davis from Nebraska and Jarquez Carter from Ohio State for 2026.
Linebacker Mohamed Toure started all 16 games in 2025 and led Miami with 84 tackles.
Defensive back Bryce Fitzgerald recorded six interceptions in 2025, tying for second nationally and leading Miami and the ACC.

coaching_changes.fact: Shannon Dawson is Miami's offensive coordinator and quarterbacks coach for 2026.
Corey Hetherman is Miami's defensive coordinator and linebackers coach, while Jason Taylor is co-defensive coordinator and defensive line coach.
Hetherman joined Miami in January 2025 after serving as Minnesota's defensive coordinator in 2024.

injury_availability.fact: Ahmad Moten Sr. missed 2026 spring football while recovering from an injury sustained in 2025, but he started each of Miami's first two 2026 games.
Mohamed Toure previously sustained season-ending ACL injuries in 2022 and 2024; he returned to start all 16 games for Miami in 2025 and both of Miami's first two games in 2026.

offensive_context.fact: Through two games, Miami averaged 61.0 points, 275.5 rushing yards, 427.0 passing yards and 702.5 total yards per game.
Miami averaged 10.0 yards per play and converted 64 percent of its third downs through its first two games.
Miami scored touchdowns on eight of its first 10 red-zone possessions in 2026.
Miami scored at least 20 points in 20 consecutive conference games through the Stanford opener.

defensive_context.fact: Miami allowed 13 total points across its first two games, beating Stanford 45-6 and Florida A&M 77-7.
Through two games, Miami's opponents averaged 57.5 rushing yards, 145.5 passing yards and 3.6 yards per play.
Miami's 2025 defense ranked first in the ACC in total defense, scoring defense and rushing defense, allowing 14.8 points per game.
The 2025 defense averaged 3.13 sacks per game, generated 25 takeaways and allowed a big play on 9.65 percent of opponent snaps.

special_teams.fact: Jake Weinberg made a 46-yard field goal and all six of his extra-point attempts in the season opener at Stanford.
Miami used three placekickers against Florida A&M: Jake Weinberg, Jack Olsen and William Rocha.

other_relevant.fact: Miami was ranked No. 5 in both the Associated Press and coaches polls after opening the season 2-0.

recent_game.fact: Clemson defeated North Carolina 28-20 on Sept. 19 to improve to 2-1 overall and 1-0 in ACC play.

Clemson trailed North Carolina by two points with 8:11 remaining when a weather delay began; after the delay, Clemson held North Carolina to a field goal and outscored the Tar Heels 13-0 over the final 5:01.
Clemson produced season highs of 401 total yards, 215 passing yards and 186 rushing yards against North Carolina.
Clemson overcame a 14-3 first-quarter deficit and a 17-15 deficit entering the fourth quarter against North Carolina.

opponent_notes.fact: Miami was 3-0 overall and 2-0 in ACC play through Sept. 20, with 155 points scored and 33 allowed.
Miami was ranked No. 6 in the Sept. 20 AP poll and No. 5 in the Sept. 20 Coaches poll.
Clemson's schedule lists Miami visiting Clemson on Oct. 3, 2026.

quarterback.fact: True freshman Tait Reynolds made his first career start against North Carolina and completed 20 of 29 passes for 215 yards, one touchdown and one interception while rushing 11 times for 26 yards.
Reynolds threw his first career touchdown pass on a 27-yard third-quarter completion to tight end Christian Bentancur.
Reynolds became Clemson's first true freshman quarterback to start within the first three games of a season since Steve Fuller and Willie Jordan in 1975.
Reynolds joined Deshaun Watson, Trevor Lawrence and DJ Uiagalelei as Clemson true freshman quarterbacks to win their starting debuts since permanent freshman eligibility began in 1972.

offensive_personnel.fact: Running back Gideon Davidson rushed 16 times for a career-high 105 yards against North Carolina, including a career-long 45-yard run and his first career touchdown on an eight-yard fourth-quarter run.
Wide receiver Tyler Brown scored on a 34-yard run in the final minute against North Carolina, his second career rushing touchdown.
Tight end Christian Bentancur recorded his first touchdown reception of the season and the fourth of his career against North Carolina.
Wide receiver T.J. Moore extended his reception streak to 30 consecutive games against North Carolina.

defensive_personnel.fact: Defensive end Will Heldt recorded two sacks against North Carolina for his second consecutive two-sack game.
Linebacker Sammy Brown recorded his first sack of the season and the 11th of his career against North Carolina.
Cornerback Elliot Washington II sealed the North Carolina win with his first interception of the season and his first interception as a Clemson player.
Linebacker Fletcher Cothran forced a third-quarter fumble against North Carolina that defensive tackle Vic Burley recovered deep in North Carolina territory.

coaching_changes.fact: Clemson's 2026 staff lists Chad Morris as offensive coordinator, Tom Allen as defensive coordinator and Rich Bisaccia as special teams coordinator.
Matt Luke is Clemson's assistant head coach, co-offensive coordinator and offensive line coach; Kyle Richardson is co-offensive coordinator and tight ends coach.
Tajh Boyd is Clemson's quarterbacks coach, C.J. Spiller coaches running backs and Tyler Grisham coaches wide receivers while serving as offensive passing game coordinator.
The guide lists Morris in the coaches booth and Allen on the field.

offensive_context.fact: Clemson entered the Cal game having rushed for at least 150 yards in two consecutive games.
Clemson entered the Cal game seeking its first consecutive games with at least 200 passing yards and 175 rushing yards since 2024.
Clemson had scored 60 points and allowed 78 through its first three games, including a 51-10 loss at LSU followed by wins over Georgia Southern and North Carolina.

defensive_context.fact: Clemson held North Carolina to 20 points and generated three takeaways: two fumble-related takeaways and a game-sealing interception.
Clemson entered the Cal game seeking consecutive games allowing fewer than 150 passing yards for the first time since 2023.
Clemson had gone four consecutive games without winning the turnover margin, finishing even three times and losing it once.

special_teams.fact: Kicker Nolan Hauser made all three field-goal attempts and his only PAT against North Carolina, improving to 9-for-9 on field goals in 2026.
Hauser entered the Cal game leading the nation in made field goals with nine and field-goal percentage at 100 percent.
Hauser had made 12 consecutive attempts from at least 40 yards dating to 2025, including a 49-yard field goal against North Carolina.

series_context.fact: Clemson is 6-4 in its last 10 meetings with Miami and lost the most recent meeting.
Clemson is 4-1 against Miami in meetings played since 2011.
Clemson defeated Miami 38-3 in the 2017 ACC Championship Game, 42-17 in 2020 and 40-10 in 2022.

other_relevant.fact: Clemson was 2-1 overall and 1-0 in ACC play before its Sept. 25 game at Cal.
Clemson's game against Miami is scheduled as a home game following the Tigers' Sept. 25 road game at Cal.
